info.title: Photoroom API
info.description: Photoroom image editing and background removal API. Includes the Image Editing v2 endpoints (Plus plan), the Remove Background endpoint (Basic plan), and the Account Details endpoint.

servers.description: Production server (Plus plan) — Image Editing v2 and Account endpoints
Production server (Basic plan) — Remove Background endpoint

get.description:
This endpoint processes an image and applies one or more edits: background removal, AI-generated backgrounds (background.prompt), realistic shadows (shadow.mode), relighting (lighting.mode), text removal (textRemoval.mode), background blur (background.blur.*), subject outline (outline.*), AI beautification (beautify.mode), AI expand (expand.mode), AI uncrop (uncrop.mode), AI upscale (upscale.mode), and positioning/resizing (padding, margin, outputSize).

Parameters are grouped by feature using dot notation: background.* for backgrounds, shadow.* for shadows, lighting.* for relighting, outline.* for subject outlines, beautify.* for AI beautification, expand.* for AI expand, uncrop.* for AI uncrop, upscale.* for AI upscale, export.* for output format, and segmentation.* for text-guided segmentation.

Edits can be combined in a single call.

It accepts a URL input for the image. If you want to directly upload an image file, please use the POST endpoint. For more details on the difference between the GET and POST endpoints, please have a look at our documentation: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api/which-endpoints-are-available.

For the simplest integration (recommended for no-code tools like Lovable), use this GET endpoint with imageUrl — no file upload handling required.

Example of a request: GET https://image-api.photoroom.com/v2/edit?imageUrl=https://example.com/photo.jpg&removeBackground=true&background.color=FFFFFF&outputSize=1000x1000&padding=0.1 with header x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY

The response is the edited image as binary data (image/png by default). To change format, set export.format to jpeg or webp.

Full documentation: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/quickstart-guide

Feature documentation:
- HD Background Removal: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/hd-background-removal
- Positioning (padding, margin, scaling): https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/positioning
- Output Size: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/output-size
- Static Background: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/static-background
- Background Blur: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/background-blur
- Subject Outline: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/subject-outline
- AI Shadows: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/ai-shadows
- AI Backgrounds: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/ai-backgrounds
- AI Relight: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/ai-relight
- AI Text Removal: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/ai-text-removal
- AI Expand: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/ai-expand
- AI Uncrop: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/ai-uncrop
- AI Beautifier: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/ai-beautifier
- AI Upscale: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/alpha-ai-upscale
- Describe Any Change: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/edit-with-ai
- Create Any Image: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/alpha-create-any-image
- Text-Guided Segmentation: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/alpha-text-guided-segmentation
- Sandbox Mode (free testing): https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/sandbox-mode

parameters.name: imageUrl
parameters.description:
URL of the main image used by the API. The GET endpoint accepts `imageUrl` only.

The maximum size of the image is 30MB.

If you want to directly upload an image file, please instead use the POST endpoint with the argument `imageFile`.

parameters.name: removeBackground
parameters.description: If enabled (default), the background of the image will be removed using PhotoRoom's award-winning algorithm

parameters.name: background.color
parameters.description:
Color of the background. If omitted, background will be transparent unless `background.imageUrl` or `background.imageFile` is provided. Can be a hex color without the hash sign (example: `FF0000`, `FF0000EE`) or color name (examples: `red`, `blue`)

When `removeBackground` is set to `false`, the color will be used to fill padding areas created by `outputSize` and any transparent areas in the original image.

parameters.name: background.imageUrl
parameters.description:
URL of the image to use as a background.

Can't be provided if `removeBackground` is set to `false`

The maximum size of the image is 30MB.

If `background.imageUrl` is provided, neither `background.imageFile` nor `background.prompt` can be provided, and vice versa.

parameters.name: background.prompt
parameters.description:
Prompt to use for guiding the background generation process.

Tips for writing high-quality prompts are available [in our documentation](https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/ai-backgrounds#how-to-write-a-high-quality-prompt).

If `background.prompt` is provided, neither `background.imageUrl` nor `background.imageFile` can be provided, and vice versa.

parameters.name: background.negativePrompt
parameters.description:
(LEGACY) This parameter will only have an effect when using the previous AI Backgrounds model, which is used when setting the header: `pr-ai-background-model-version: 2`

A negative prompt to use for guiding the background generation process; If provided, the generation algorithm will try to avoid properties listed in the negativePrompt.

parameters.name: background.expandPrompt
parameters.description:
If `ai.auto`, a pre-processing step is applied to expand the prompt into a longer form.

`auto` and `never` are legacy values that will be removed in the next major version.

mode.description:
If `ai.auto`, a pre-processing step is applied to expand the prompt into a longer form.

Example: original prompt `"on a beach"`, expanded prompt: `"An object rests on the sandy shore of a tranquil beach. The object, partially covered in sand, casts a soft shadow under the warm sunlight. Seashells and driftwood are scattered around, with gentle waves lapping at the shore in the background, creating a serene coastal scene."`

(Note: `background.expandPrompt.mode` only affects `background.prompt`)

parameters.name: background.seed
parameters.description: Seed used to generate the background. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same prompt.

parameters.name: background.scaling
parameters.description:
Whether the background should fit or fill (default) the output image. If set to `fit`, the empty pixels will be transparent.

Can only be provided if `background.imageUrl` or `background.imageFile` is provided.

parameters.name: background.guidance.imageUrl
parameters.description:
URL of the image to use as a background image guidance.

Can't be provided if `removeBackground` is set to `false`

The maximum size of the image is 30MB.

parameters.name: background.guidance.imageFile
parameters.description:
Bytes of the image to use as a background image guidance. Only available in the POST request.

Can't be provided if `removeBackground` is set to `false`

The maximum size of the image is 30MB.

parameters.name: background.guidance.scale
parameters.description:
How closely the generated background will be matching the guiding image, between 0 and 1.

A value of 1 means it will match the guiding image as much as possible, a value of 0 means the guiding image will be ignored.

(Only working when using the [new model](https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/ai-backgrounds#important-model-selection))

parameters.name: background.blur.mode
parameters.description:
Type of blur to apply to the background.
- `gaussian`: Applies a gaussian blur to the background.
- `bokeh`: Applies a bokeh blur to the background.

parameters.name: background.blur.radius
parameters.description:
Radius of the blur effect. Higher values mean the result will be blurrier.

Minimum: 0, Maximum: 0.05

parameters.name: shadow.mode
parameters.description: Shadow generation mode to use on the main image used by the API. If set to `ai.soft`, a soft shadow will be generated. If set to `ai.hard`, a hard shadow will be generated. If set to `ai.floating`, a floating shadow will be generated.

parameters.name: lighting.mode
parameters.description:
Lighting mode to use on the main image used by the API.

If set to `ai.auto`, the lighting will be automatically adjusted.

If set to `ai.preserve-hue-and-saturation`, the lighting will be adjusted while keeping color hues and saturations as close as possible to the original image.

parameters.name: textRemoval.mode
parameters.description:
Text removal mode to use on the main image used by the API.

If set to `ai.artificial`, artificial text will be automatically removed. Artificial text includes all text added on an image through post-processing, such as company name, watermarks, discount, etc.

If set to `ai.natural`, natural text will be automatically removed. Natural text includes text that naturally occurs in an image such as writing on buildings or clothings, road signs, etc.

If set to `ai.all`, all text (natural and artificial) will be automatically removed.

parameters.name: outline.color
parameters.description: Apply a colored outline around the subject to highlight it. Can be a hex color without the hash sign (example: `FF0000`, `FF0000EE`) or color name (examples: `red`, `blue`).

parameters.name: outline.width
parameters.description:
Width of the outline relative to the image size. Suggested values:
- 0.01-0.02: Subtle/thin outline
- 0.03-0.05: Standard/medium outline (default: 0.03)
- 0.06-0.1: Bold/thick outline
The value represents a ratio where 0.1 (10%) is the maximum thickness.

Minimum: 0, Maximum: 0.1

parameters.name: outline.blurRadius
parameters.description:
Blur radius for the outline, creating a glow or soft edge effect. Higher values mean the outline will be more blurred, 0 means no blur.

Minimum: 0, Maximum: 0.025

parameters.name: beautify.mode
parameters.description:
If enabled, the input image will be beautified (imageFile or imageUrl).

This is intended to enhance product images by automatically improving the aesthetics of the image, such as the lighting, background, and overall appearance.

If set to `ai.auto`, the input image will be beautified to match the aesthetic of a packshot product image.

If set to `ai.food`, the input image will be beautified in a way that's specific to food images, such as placing the subject on a plate.

If set to `ai.car`, the input image will be beautified in a way that's specific to car images, such as removing reflections.

Important:
- the beautifier will not preserve the original background: we recommend using this option along with `removeBackground` set to `true`
- the beautifier is meant for images of products, food, or cars; we do not recommend using it with subjects such as humans, pets, etc.

parameters.name: beautify.seed
parameters.description: Seed used to run the subject beautifier. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same subject.

parameters.name: expand.mode
parameters.description:
Expand mode to use on the main image used by the API.

If set to `ai.auto`, all transparent pixels will automatically be filled based on the content of the current background (either the original background, if `removeBackground` has been set to `false`, or a static background, if `background.imageUrl` has been provided).

Expand will rely on output size, subject position, and fitting mode.

parameters.name: expand.seed
parameters.description: Seed used to generate the background. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same prompt.

parameters.name: uncrop.mode
parameters.description:
Uncrop mode to use on the main image used by the API.

Currently, only `ai.auto` is supported. With `ai.auto`, the subject will be automatically detected and uncropped.

parameters.name: uncrop.seed
parameters.description: Seed used to generate the background. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same prompt.

parameters.name: upscale.mode
parameters.description:
(ALPHA) Warning: might get deprecated with a 2 weeks warning.

If enabled, the input image will be upscaled (imageFile or imageUrl).

The input image must not exceed 1000x1000 pixels in dimensions when using `ai.fast` mode. The input image must not exceed 512x512 pixels in dimensions when using `ai.slow` mode.

The upscaling process will enlarge the input image up to 4 times its original size.

ai.fast: Optimized for speed, may not produce the highest quality results.
ai.slow: Optimized for quality, may take more time to process.

parameters.name: editWithAI.mode
parameters.description:
Edit with AI mode to use on the main image used by the API.

Currently, only `ai.auto` is supported.

parameters.name: editWithAI.prompt
parameters.description: The natural language prompt describing the change to apply to the image.

parameters.name: editWithAI.seed
parameters.description: Seed used for the generation. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same prompt.

parameters.name: describeAnyChange.mode
parameters.description:
(DEPRECATED) Use `editWithAI.mode` instead.

Describe any change mode to use on the main image used by the API.

Currently, only `ai.auto` is supported.

parameters.name: describeAnyChange.prompt
parameters.description:
(DEPRECATED) Use `editWithAI.prompt` instead.

The natural language prompt describing the change to apply to the image.

parameters.name: describeAnyChange.seed
parameters.description:
(DEPRECATED) Use `editWithAI.seed` instead.

Seed used for the generation. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same prompt.

parameters.name: imageFromPrompt.prompt
parameters.description: The prompt to use for generating the image.

parameters.name: imageFromPrompt.seed
parameters.description: Seed used to run the AI image generator. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same prompt.

parameters.name: imageFromPrompt.size
parameters.description: Supported sizes for AI image generation.

parameters.name: segmentation.mode
parameters.description: Controls whether or not the salient object should be kept or ignored by the segmentation model.

parameters.name: segmentation.prompt
parameters.description: A textual description of what the segmentation should keep.

parameters.name: segmentation.negativePrompt
parameters.description: A textual description of what the segmentation should remove.

parameters.name: export.format
parameters.description:
The format of the result image.

Default value is "png".

Jpeg exports with a quality of 80 and WebP exports with a quality of 90.

parameters.name: export.dpi
parameters.description:
The pixel density of the result image.

Pixel density can be set to any value between 72 and 1200 dpi.

parameters.name: outputSize
parameters.description:
Output size of the image. In the form of either:
- `auto` to keep the template dimensions when templateId is defined, or behave like `originalImage` when templateId isn't defined (default)
- `widthxheight` for a custom size (example: `200x400`)
- `originalImage` to keep the original image dimensions
- `croppedSubject` to use the size of the foreground dimensions after cropping around it

parameters.name: padding
parameters.description:
General padding around the subject. Can be expressed as a number between 0 and 0.49, a percentage string between 0% and 49% (e.g., "30%"), or a pixel value string (e.g., "100px"). Unlike `margin`, padding will be ignored on cropped sides of the subject if that option is enabled. Expressed in a ratio of the size of the document, minus margins (similar to CSS).

Tips: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/positioning

parameters.name: paddingTop
parameters.description: Top padding, overrides general padding on the top side. Accepts the same formats as `padding`.

parameters.name: paddingBottom
parameters.description: Bottom padding, overrides general padding on the bottom side. Accepts the same formats as `padding`.

parameters.name: paddingLeft
parameters.description: Left padding, overrides general padding on the left side. Accepts the same formats as `padding`.

parameters.name: paddingRight
parameters.description: Right padding, overrides general padding on the right side. Accepts the same formats as `padding`.

parameters.name: margin
parameters.description:
General margin around the subject. Can be expressed as a number between 0 and 0.49, a percentage string between 0% and 49% (e.g., "30%"), or a pixel value string (e.g., "100px"). Unlike `padding`, margin is never ignored even on cropped sides of the subject. Expressed in a ratio of the output image size.

Tips: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/positioning

parameters.name: marginTop
parameters.description: Top Margin, overrides general margin on the top side. Accepts the same formats as `margin`.

parameters.name: marginBottom
parameters.description: Bottom Margin, overrides general margin on the bottom side. Accepts the same formats as `margin`.

parameters.name: marginLeft
parameters.description: Left Margin, overrides general margin on the left side. Accepts the same formats as `margin`.

parameters.name: marginRight
parameters.description: Right Margin, overrides general margin on the right side. Accepts the same formats as `margin`.

parameters.name: scaling
parameters.description:
Whether the subject should fit (default) or fill the output image. If set to `fit`, the empty pixels will be transparent.

Can only be provided if `imageUrl` or `imageFile` is provided.

parameters.name: maxWidth
parameters.description: Maximum output width. Can only be provided if `outputSize` is `originalImage` or `croppedSubject`. Useful for resizing an image while keeping the aspect ratio.

parameters.name: maxHeight
parameters.description: Maximum output height. Can only be provided if `outputSize` is `originalImage` or `croppedSubject`. Useful for redimensioning while keeping the aspect ratio.

parameters.name: horizontalAlignment
parameters.description:
[Advanced] Defines the horizontal alignment of the cutout subject within its bounding box.

Specifying a custom horizontal alignment will implicitly set `ignorePaddingAndSnapOnCroppedSides` to `false` for the horizontal direction.

parameters.name: verticalAlignment
parameters.description:
[Advanced] Defines the vertical alignment of the cutout subject within its bounding box.

Specifying a custom vertical alignment will implicitly set `ignorePaddingAndSnapOnCroppedSides` to `false` for the vertical direction.

parameters.name: ignorePaddingAndSnapOnCroppedSides
parameters.description:
If set to `true` (default), cropped sides of the subject will snap to the edges. For instance, for a portrait image cropped below the elbows, the subject will be aligned at the bottom even if a bottom padding is provided (but it will still respect bottom margin).

Can't be provided if `removeBackground` is set to `false`.

parameters.name: referenceBox
parameters.description:
[Advanced] `subjectBox` by default. When set to `originalImage`, the padding/margin will be around the original image and not the cropped subject.

Can't be provided if `removeBackground` is set to `false`.

parameters.name: keepExistingAlphaChannel
parameters.description: If set to `auto` and if the image has transparency, the existing transparency will be used to cutout the subject.

parameters.name: preserveMetadata
parameters.description:
Controls which metadata from the original image will be preserved in the output image.

- `never`: No metadata preservation (default)
- `xmp`: Preserve XMP metadata including camera settings, copyright information, and other embedded metadata
- `exifSubset`: Preserve EXIF Copyright (IFD0) and UserComment (ExifIFD) fields only

parameters.name: templateId
parameters.description: The ID of the template to render.

parameters.name: flatLay.mode
parameters.description: Must be set to `ai.auto` to enable flat lay generation.

parameters.name: flatLay.prompt
parameters.description: Optional text prompt to guide the generation style.

parameters.name: flatLay.size
parameters.description: The output size of the generated image.

parameters.name: ghostMannequin.mode
parameters.description: Must be set to `ai.auto` to enable ghost mannequin generation.

parameters.name: ghostMannequin.prompt
parameters.description: Optional text prompt to guide the generation style.

parameters.name: ghostMannequin.size
parameters.description: The output size of the generated image.

parameters.name: virtualModel.mode
parameters.description: Must be set to `ai.auto` to enable virtual model generation.

parameters.name: virtualModel.prompt
parameters.description: Optional text prompt to guide the generation style.

parameters.name: virtualModel.pose
parameters.description: The pose of the model in the generated image.

parameters.name: virtualModel.quality
parameters.description: The output quality of the generated image. Higher quality produces larger images. `standard` outputs ~1K, `advanced` ~2K, and `premium` ~4K resolution.

parameters.name: virtualModel.size
parameters.description: The output size of the generated image.

parameters.name: virtualModel.model
parameters.description: The model (person) to use for the virtual try-on. Either a preset model name or a custom image.

imageFile.description: Bytes of a custom model image. Only available in the POST request.

imageUrl.description: URL of a custom model image.

parameters.name: virtualModel.scene
parameters.description: The scene (background/environment) to use. Either a preset scene name or a custom image.

imageFile.description: Bytes of a custom scene image. Only available in the POST request.

imageUrl.description: URL of a custom scene image.

parameters.name: virtualModel.additionalProductImages
parameters.description: Additional product images showing different angles or details of the same item. These help the model better understand the product and generate more accurate results.

imageFile.description: Bytes of an additional product image. Only available in the POST request.

imageUrl.description: URL of an additional product image.

200.description: OK — The edited image as binary data

pr-ai-background-seed.description: The seed used when generating the background. Can be used to get similar looking results for the same prompt.

pr-texts-detected.description: When removing texts from an image, it will return the number of texts detected.

pr-unsupported-attributes.description: [Temporary] If the request contains attributes that are not supported by the API, this header will be returned with a list of the unsupported attributes. Soon to be replaced by a 400 Bad Request response.

pr-edit-further-url.description: A URL to open the result of the API call in the Photoroom webapp and edit it further.

post.description:
This endpoint processes an image and applies one or more edits: background removal, AI-generated backgrounds (background.prompt), realistic shadows (shadow.mode), relighting (lighting.mode), text removal (textRemoval.mode), background blur (background.blur.*), subject outline (outline.*), AI beautification (beautify.mode), AI expand (expand.mode), AI uncrop (uncrop.mode), AI upscale (upscale.mode), and positioning/resizing (padding, margin, outputSize).

Edits can be combined in a single call.

It accepts an image file for the image. If you want to send a URL, please use the GET endpoint. For more details: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api/which-endpoints-are-available.

Use this POST endpoint when you need to upload image files directly as multipart/form-data.

Full documentation: https://docs.photoroom.com/image-editing-api-plus-plan/quickstart-guide

imageFile.description:
Bytes of the main image used by the API. The POST endpoint accepts `imageFile` only.

The maximum size of the image is 30MB.

If you want to send the URL of an image, please instead use the GET endpoint with the argument `imageUrl`.

removeBackground.description: If enabled (default), the background of the image will be removed using PhotoRoom's award-winning algorithm.

background.color.description: Color of the background. Can be a hex color without the hash sign or color name.

Bytes of the image to use as a background. Only available in the POST request.

Can't be provided if `removeBackground` is set to `false`.

The maximum size of the image is 30MB.
